parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, police targeting, facility ban, document or custody exposure is documented, and same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2022 via a successful court challenge. That sets a moderate baseline. It is held down by documented official/religious hostility, no distinct traveller protection, employment law excluding gender identity, and a 2018 meat-cleaver attack punished only by a $460 fine with no jail time, showing thin recourse for anti-trans violence. The violence evidence is a single dated incident, so it signals impunity rather than a current rate. Thin data on entry, facilities and care prevents a higher score.

entry_documents.exposure: State does not screen or protect LGBT travellers as a distinct category and has questioned legitimacy of LGBT migration; no documented document-mismatch practice.
entry_documents.interaction: No documented border identity-check regime interacts with decriminalisation; traveller documents are foreign-issued.

federal_state_facilities.interaction: Single island-wide regime documented; no subnational variation or facility rule documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Official and religious hostility documented: government resistance to external pressure on sodomy law, fundamentalist calls to encourage discrimination, opposition to gay tourism. No trans expression offence documented; sodomy decriminalised 2022.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: High court found sexual-orientation discrimination unconstitutional and decriminalised same-sex conduct; PM reported pro-LGBT and some church opposition to buggery law.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Decriminalisation removes a latent police lever, but hostile framing can still license social hostility and weak enforcement for trans victims.

minors_guardians.interaction: Former serious-indecency provision concerning persons aged 16+ is unresolved; no traveller-facing minor rule documented.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 2018 meat-cleaver attack caused serious throat injuries; Pride/vigil presence alongside activist account of visibility and danger suggests friction and hostility. Single dated incident, not a documented rate.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Conviction without jail time or meaningful penalty undermines police/court recourse if a traveller is assaulted.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Employment non-discrimination act excludes gender identity/expression; no hate-crime or traveller remedy documented; regional case outcome unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Constitutional litigation succeeded in 2022, showing courts can provide relief on sexuality law.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Resident employment exclusion is a climate signal only; for travellers the operative gap is absence of documented trans-specific recourse.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in that no imprisonment followed a mismatch and courts provided relief, but lower because this dossier documents no working traveller remedy, apology or compensation, and documents a $460 fine for a cleaver attack rather than accountability for officials.

Higher than 0.55-B because that anchor has routine extended secondary screening and discretionary refusal for every affected traveller; here no universal border, registration or facility exposure is documented, though thin recourse keeps the case below 0.65.

Materially higher than 0.35-C, which imposes mandatory lodging reporting, eviction and fund freezes with no effective challenge; here there is no documented mandatory reporting, eviction, arrest or imprisonment regime for trans visitors.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: decriminalisation and a functioning constitutional court are real positives, but they concern sexuality law, not documented trans traveller protections. The operative risks if outed are social hostility, unaided discrimination, and weak prosecution of severe anti-trans violence, with entry, facilities, custody and care undocumented rather than proven safe. That places the case in tier-3 societal hostility with thin recourse, above universal-exposure anchors and below anchors where remedies demonstrably work.
